deliverables: Performance optimization with 2x to 10x improvements in snapshot signing and memory profile and reduced L1 fees through on-chain contract optimization.
Operational excellence including operator runbooks, simpler node configuration, observability and logging, and an improved TUI.
Ecosystem support including production-user and pipeline-integrator features, Hydra Alliance facilitation, hackathons, and developer relations.
Maintenance and developer experience work including CI, tooling, and technical debt reduction.
Milestone-gated delivery with independent third-party assurance and Intersect administrative treasury governance.
request.what: Fund Hydra v2 production hardening and performance improvements across performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and developer experience.

claims.claim: Hydra is described as the only production-grade or production-ready Layer 2 scaling solution on Cardano.
The proposal states that Hydra is already used or has powered Delta DeFi, Masumi, Hydra Doom, Glacier Drop, Intersect voting infrastructure, VTech Labs, Blockfrost, and Midgard.
The proposal claims Hydra provides sub-second or near-instant finality, near-zero or zero transaction costs inside a head, and high throughput while settling back to Cardano L1.
The proposal claims Cardano L1 has over two hours of finality, approximately $0.17 payment transaction fees, and roughly 7 to 10 TPS, making high-performance use cases uncompetitive on L1.
The proposal claims competing platforms offer 400ms to 2s finality, sub-cent fees, and 1,000 to 7,000+ TPS, causing some builders to exclude Cardano at selection stage.
The proposal claims the funded performance workstream will deliver 2x to 10x improvements in snapshot signing and memory profile and reduce L1 fees through contract optimization.
The proposal claims Hydra applications can increase Cardano L1 fee revenue through head opening, fund addition or removal, closure, settlement transactions, and optionally routed internal fees.
The proposal states the funding ask is ₳5,100,781 and will be milestone-gated with independent third-party assurance and Intersect administrative treasury governance.
The proposal claims Hydra advances treasury KPIs for TVL, monthly active users, monthly transactions, throughput capacity, reliability and uptime, and annual protocol revenue.
The proposal claims many current Hydra use cases rely on the proposed improvements and may migrate to competing chains if delivery slips.

summary: The document requests ₳5,100,781 for Hydra v2 hardening and adoption work, presents strong technical and ecosystem-benefit claims, but most material adoption, competitive, economic, budget, and delivery-impact claims are asserted rather than substantiated within the anchor text.
